title: Ai development orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai development orchestrator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users

Start: Immediate

The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.

The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.

What You Do

Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.

Must-Haves

Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.

Strong Signals

Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy.

Red Flags

AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.

Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.

How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.

What We Offer

A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.

To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Aqui você vai encontrar benefícios como:

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico Sul América com cobertura nacional, custeado em 100% pela empresa. Wellhub (Gympass) ou reembolso de academia. Aplicativo para agendamento de massagem. Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação pagos no cartão i Food.

Auxílio Home Office pago no cartão i Food. PLR de acordo com as regras vigentes. Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas. Gran Pix - Programa de reconhecimento de projetos com premiações. Auxílio-Creche.

Bolsa de estudos integral para Graduação e Pós-Graduação na Gran Faculdade. Assinatura Ilimitada Gran Concursos gratuita. Gran Academy - Universidade Corporativa para desenvolvimento dos Gran Lovers. Políticas de incentivo ao estudo, promovendo o aprendizado contínuo.

Kit onboarding e equipamentos disponibilizados pelo Gran. Vale Natal em dezembro. Kit Gran Baby, um presente para celebrar o nascimento de bebês na família. M. O. Day Off no aniversário. Seguro de vida.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Support analyst l2 - bilingual
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Support analyst l2 - bilingual em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description

Please submit resumes in English. Strong English speaking and writing communication skills are required.

As a Support Analyst L2, you will troubleshoot operational issues with the Warehouse Management System (WMS), manage configurations, support cloud solutions, monitor SQL performance, and maintain documentation. You bring expertise with Oracle Web Logic Server, Oracle Databases, cloud services, Linux systems, supply chain technologies, and various hardware/software tools used in warehouse and distribution operations.

What a day in the life looks like:

Troubleshoot business and operational issues associated with the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and ancillary software. Quantify issues and provide supporting data if issues are escalated to the ERP Vendor. Manage the WMS environments and migration of configurations between environments. Support the operation and continuous improvement of the monitoring of our cloud solutions. SQL performance monitoring, index, and query tuning. Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, troubleshooting steps, and support processes for future reference and knowledgebase articles.

What you bring to the team:

BS/BA in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent; 5+ years of technical customer support experience. 3+ years of experience with SQL/Oracle. Advantage: Experience in software development. Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services (AWS, Azure, OCI, Google Cloud). Advantage: Experience with supply chain, distribution, and interface technologies.

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assessor de investimentos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da geral:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Profissional Financeiro com certificação CPA-10 ou CPA-20 para atuar no suporte e atendimento a clientes, análise de perfil de investidor, e distribuição de produtos financeiros. O(a) profissional ideal tem perfil analítico, boa comunicação e experiência no setor bancário ou de investimentos.

Responsabilidades:

Prestar atendimento e suporte técnico/consultivo a clientes pessoa física e jurídica; Realizar análises de perfil de investidor (suitability) e apoiar na recomendação de produtos financeiros; Comercializar produtos como CDB, LCI/LCA, fundos de investimento, previdência, entre outros; Apoiar a área comercial no processo de prospecção e fidelização de clientes; Atualizar cadastros, monitorar prazos e garantir conformidade com as normas da ANBIMA e do BACEN; Acompanhar indicadores e relatórios de desempenho da carteira de investimentos.

Requisitos:

Certificação CPA-10 ou CPA-20 (obrigatória); Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito ou corretoras; Conhecimento em produtos bancários e investimentos; Facilidade com sistemas bancários, Excel e plataformas de investimento; Boa comunicação, proatividade e foco em resultados.

Diferenciais:

Certificações adicionais (CEA, CFP, ANCORD); Vivência com atendimento consultivo em agências bancárias ou mesas de investimentos; Domínio de ferramentas como Smarkia, BLK, ou plataformas de investimentos digitais.

Benefícios:

Salário compatível com o mercado Participação nos lucros (PLR) Vale-refeição e alimentação Plano de saúde e odontológico Previdência privada Programa de desenvolvimento e capacitação contínua

title: Hnw client manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hnw client manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote | Athens HQ support Independent Contractor Uncapped commission with strong earning potential for top performers

Who We Are

Ambitious people deserve options regardless of where they were born.

Pass Beyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families — gaining Schengen access, international asset diversification, and long-term optionality.

Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. Pass Beyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.

We're looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from your network.

The Role

This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals — and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.

You will:

Introduce Pass Beyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks — so they can make an informed decision Guide clients from first conversation through to permit in hand Build trust through genuine conversation — not scripts or pressure tactics Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters

We're not looking for cold-callers. We're looking for trusted advisors.

Who Our Clients Are

Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest Successful individuals who have built or grown significant wealth Discerning clients who value due diligence and take time to make important decisions Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families They value relationships over transactions and won't be rushed or pressured

Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their care in decision-making, and guides with patience and honesty.

What We're Looking For

Essential:

Existing relationships with high-net-worth individuals Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you'd serve Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal) Comfortable with performance-based compensation Integrity - you'd rather lose a deal than mislead someone

Highly Desirable:

Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services

Backgrounds that often do well:

Business owners and entrepreneurs Private bankers and wealth managers Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets Community leaders and well-connected professionals

What You Get

Full training and certification on our programmes — no cost to you Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens) Psychological messaging framework and conversation guides designed for high-stakes, trust-based advisory — not generic sales scripts CRM system for pipeline management Branded marketing materials and property documents ready to share with clients Direct support from our Athens headquarters — legal coordination, transaction management, and immigration filing handled for you As we grow together, you'll receive warm leads from our marketing campaigns alongside your own network

Our Values

Freedom — The right to become who you are capable of becoming, unconstrained by the circumstances of your birth.

Integrity — Not a character trait, but an infrastructure. We engineer trustworthiness into every process.

Partnership — We build relationships, not transactions. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.

title: Junior web developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior web developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Lumexa Capital -

A Lumexa é uma empresa de tecnologia e capital que combina inteligência de mercado com software sob medida para gerar resultado real. Trabalhamos com operações enxutas, ferramentas próprias e uma mentalidade de builder — cada sistema que construímos existe para resolver um problema concreto, não para encher portfólio.

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

Full‐Stack Development

Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‐scale data migrations and cross‐platform synchronization. Perform deep‐dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority. Expert level AWS development experience, especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‐level AWS development experience‐driven architectures. Strong full‐stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred). Proven track record developing REST APIs, microservices, and cloud‐native applications. Hands‐on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs. Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‐scale migration tooling. Solid understanding of CI/CD and Dev Ops tooling (Git Hub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.).

Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly. Strong analytical and root‐cause debugging skills. Ability to collaborate with cross‐functional business and engineering teams.

Experience with Event Bridge, App Flow, or enterprise i Paa S tools. Background in M& A system consolidation or multi‐system enterprise architecture.

title: Ai development orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai development orchestrator em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users

Start: Immediate

The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.

The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.

What You Do

Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.

Must-Haves

Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.

Strong Signals

Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy.

Red Flags

AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.

Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.

How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.

What We Offer

A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.

To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero

Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.

We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.

The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.

About the Role

This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS.

You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.

What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Full Stack Engineering

Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.

AWS native Architecture

Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized.

Systems Integration

Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

AI Forward Development

Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform.

Collaboration & Impact

Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.

What We Are Looking For

8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.

Why Freight Hero

Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em desenvolvimento de negócios (b2b) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

NÓS AJUDAMOS AS PESSOAS A ATINGIR SEUS OBJETIVOS NO MERCADO FINANCEIRO! TOPA VIR COM A GENTE?

Somos uma fintech que une tecnologia e inovação em um mercado que não para de crescer!

Desde 2019, o aplicativo Grana simplifica o cálculo de Imposto de Renda para investidores da bolsa. Hoje, estamos expandindo nossa atuação com novos produtos:

Grana Pro, voltado para contadores e assessores que atendem investidores; Grana Smart, que utiliza Open Finance e Inteligência Artificial para dar mais clareza e controle sobre a vida financeira das pessoas.

Estamos em um momento de construção e crescimento, abrindo novas frentes, testando caminhos e evoluindo nossos produtos com base em quem usa.

Conheça mais sobre nossa proposta e funcionalidades em:

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

O Grana Pro é nossa frente B2 B e está em fase de construção. Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na linha de frente desse crescimento, ajudando a desenvolver e escalar a base de clientes.

Essa posição envolve desde a prospecção e apresentação do produto até o acompanhamento do cliente ao longo da jornada, com um papel ativo na construção da estratégia comercial e na evolução do produto.

Aqui, você terá autonomia, contato direto com o mercado e a oportunidade real de construir algo do zero.

Se isso te descreve, essa vaga é para você!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Mapear e prospectar ativamente contadores e assessores — levantamento de mercado, abordagem por e-mail, Linked In, Whats App e telefone, campanhas de marketing; Apresentar o produto em demonstrações por vídeo ou presencialmente, conectando as funcionalidades às dores reais de cada cliente; Acompanhar o funil de ponta a ponta, analisar a conversão e propor ações concretas para melhorar os números; Fazer o acompanhamento pós-venda, garantir que o cliente use o produto e vire referência; Dar retorno direto sobre o produto com base no que vê no dia a dia;

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Experiência em vendas consultivas ou gestão de contas B2 B; Facilidade para entender e explicar produtos com alguma complexidade (fiscal, tributária ou financeira); Perfil que constrói carteira de clientes do zero, sem esperar o contato chegar; Boa comunicação escrita e verbal; Capacidade de olhar a estratégia ampla para definir caminhos e, ao mesmo tempo, se envolver nos detalhes operacionais. Mentalidade \"0 a 1\": perfil auto-motivado que tenha paixão por construir e vontade de desenvolver uma prática de vendas B2 B do zero.

Será um diferencial:

Conhecimento pessoal ou profissional em investimentos (especialmente bolsa de valores); Experiência com contadores e assessores de contabilidade.

title: Executivo de parcerias estratégicas — grupo studio
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo de parcerias estratégicas — grupo studio em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Seja um Executivo de Parcerias Estratégicas do Grupo Studio

Você é consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com perfil para chegar até decisores C-level?

Quer prospectar empresas, oferecer uma solução de alto impacto e gerar uma nova e significativa fonte de receita para você?

O Grupo Studio está expandindo sua rede de Parceiros Estratégicos em todo o Brasil. Com 30 anos de atuação consolidada, já atendemos mais de 35 mil empresas, contamos com mais de 350 sócios ativos na nossa rede e identificamos R$16 bilhões em benefícios para nossos cliente e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso.

Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária e fiscal brasileira em benefício real para as empresas, com metodologia exclusiva e décadas de expertise comprovada. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos Parceiros com perfil comercial, disposição para prospectar e vontade de crescer conosco.

Quem buscamos? O Parceiro ideal

Você tem habilidade para chegar até os decisores certos?

Tem uma carteira de clientes formada. Buscamos pessoas com perfil comercial, facilidade de comunicação e disposição para prospectar empresas especialmente aquelas enquadradas em Lucro Presumido ou Real. Se você sabe abrir portas e construir relacionamentos, temos tudo o que você precisa para fechar negócios.

Você quer construir uma fonte de receita expressiva do zero?

Você não precisa chegar com nada pronto nós fornecemos o produto, o treinamento, o suporte técnico e a marca. Você traz o perfil comercial e a disposição de ir atrás. Buscamos parceiros que pensem em construir algo sólido, não em um fechamento isolado.

O que oferecemos em nossa parceria:

Produto pronto para vender, você não precisa criar nada. As soluções do Grupo Studio têm 30 anos de metodologia validada e uma proposta de valor que se vende pela lógica o cliente não tem nada a perder.

Modelo de receita 100% no êxito

Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita sem limite de ganhos você recebe quando o seu cliente recebe o benefício.

Treinamento e capacitação completos

Você não precisa saber nada sobre tributação para começar. Nossa equipe te capacita do zero - produto, abordagem comercial e argumentação.

Suporte em todas as etapas

Da prospecção ao fechamento, nossa equipe técnica e comercial estará ao seu lado para apoiar cada negociação.

Força de uma marca consolidada

Você chega ao cliente respaldado por uma rede com 30 anos de história e mais de 35 mil empresas atendidas em todo o Brasil.

Você se identifica com este perfil?

Se você tem perfil comercial, vontade de prospectar e busca uma nova fonte de receita sem risco, esta é a oportunidade certa. Estamos selecionando Executivos de Parcerias em todo o Brasil e as vagas são limitadas por região.

Vagas limitadas por região. Candidaturas abertas para todo o Brasil.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Ingeniero de nube
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ingeniero de nube em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Top Skills' Details

1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations.

2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development).

3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery.

3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred).

4.) Hands on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs.

Job Description:

Our Client is the nation's leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‐integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience, strong full‐stack engineering skills, and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‐native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically Net Suite, Salesforce, and other enterprise applications.

You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‐on coding and deployment automation.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise System Integration

Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS, Net Suite, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems. Design and implement RESTful APIs, event‐driven integrations, and data‐sync pipelines. Lead integration efforts during M& A system consolidation, ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms.

AWS Engineering & Architecture

Build serverless and microservices‐based applications using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, Event Bridge, SNS/SQS, and related AWS services. Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns.

Full‐Stack Development

Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern Java Script/Type Script frameworks. Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes.

Advanced Development & Data Workflows

Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce Net Suite AWS).‐performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce Net Suite AWS). Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‐scale data migrations and cross‐platform synchronization. Perform deep‐dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‐vs‐Buy recommendations. Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority. Expert level AWS development experience, especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‐level AWS development experience‐driven architectures. Strong full‐stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred). Proven track record developing REST APIs, microservices, and cloud‐native applications. Hands‐on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs. Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‐scale migration tooling. Solid understanding of CI/CD and Dev Ops tooling (Git Hub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.).

Soft Skills

Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly. Strong analytical and root‐cause debugging skills. Ability to collaborate with cross‐functional business and engineering teams.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Event Bridge, App Flow, or enterprise i Paa S tools. Background in M& A system consolidation or multi‐system enterprise architecture.

title: Hnw client manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hnw client manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote | Athens HQ support Independent Contractor Uncapped commission with strong earning potential for top performers

Who We Are

Ambitious people deserve options regardless of where they were born.

Pass Beyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families — gaining Schengen access, international asset diversification, and long-term optionality.

Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. Pass Beyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.

We're looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from your network.

The Role

This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals — and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.

You will:

Introduce Pass Beyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks — so they can make an informed decision Guide clients from first conversation through to permit in hand Build trust through genuine conversation — not scripts or pressure tactics Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters

We're not looking for cold-callers. We're looking for trusted advisors.

Who Our Clients Are

Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest Successful individuals who have built or grown significant wealth Discerning clients who value due diligence and take time to make important decisions Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families They value relationships over transactions and won't be rushed or pressured

Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their care in decision-making, and guides with patience and honesty.

What We're Looking For

Essential:

Existing relationships with high-net-worth individuals Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you'd serve Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal) Comfortable with performance-based compensation Integrity - you'd rather lose a deal than mislead someone

Highly Desirable:

Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services

Backgrounds that often do well:

Business owners and entrepreneurs Private bankers and wealth managers Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets Community leaders and well-connected professionals

What You Get

Full training and certification on our programmes — no cost to you Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens) Psychological messaging framework and conversation guides designed for high-stakes, trust-based advisory — not generic sales scripts CRM system for pipeline management Branded marketing materials and property documents ready to share with clients Direct support from our Athens headquarters — legal coordination, transaction management, and immigration filing handled for you As we grow together, you'll receive warm leads from our marketing campaigns alongside your own network

Our Values

Freedom — The right to become who you are capable of becoming, unconstrained by the circumstances of your birth.

Integrity — Not a character trait, but an infrastructure. We engineer trustworthiness into every process.

Partnership — We build relationships, not transactions. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.

title: Hnw client manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hnw client manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote | Athens HQ support Independent Contractor Uncapped commission with strong earning potential for top performers

Who We Are

Ambitious people deserve options regardless of where they were born.

Pass Beyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families — gaining Schengen access, international asset diversification, and long-term optionality.

Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. Pass Beyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.

We're looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from your network.

The Role

This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals — and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.

You will:

Introduce Pass Beyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks — so they can make an informed decision Guide clients from first conversation through to permit in hand Build trust through genuine conversation — not scripts or pressure tactics Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters

We're not looking for cold-callers. We're looking for trusted advisors.

Who Our Clients Are

Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest Successful individuals who have built or grown significant wealth Discerning clients who value due diligence and take time to make important decisions Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families They value relationships over transactions and won't be rushed or pressured

Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their care in decision-making, and guides with patience and honesty.

What We're Looking For

Essential:

Existing relationships with high-net-worth individuals Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you'd serve Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal) Comfortable with performance-based compensation Integrity - you'd rather lose a deal than mislead someone

Highly Desirable:

Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services

Backgrounds that often do well:

Business owners and entrepreneurs Private bankers and wealth managers Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets Community leaders and well-connected professionals

What You Get

Full training and certification on our programmes — no cost to you Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens) Psychological messaging framework and conversation guides designed for high-stakes, trust-based advisory — not generic sales scripts CRM system for pipeline management Branded marketing materials and property documents ready to share with clients Direct support from our Athens headquarters — legal coordination, transaction management, and immigration filing handled for you As we grow together, you'll receive warm leads from our marketing campaigns alongside your own network

Our Values

Freedom — The right to become who you are capable of becoming, unconstrained by the circumstances of your birth.

Integrity — Not a character trait, but an infrastructure. We engineer trustworthiness into every process.

Partnership — We build relationships, not transactions. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.

description:

Here at Zallpy, technology is born from curious, collaborative people with a desire to do things well. If you like environments where there's room to ask questions, test, learn, and evolve together, check out this opportunity!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Zallpy, we value an environment where everyone can be themselves, with respect, safety, and a sense of belonging. We especially encourage applications from people with disabilities and guarantee an accessible environment with adaptations and support throughout the journey.

We also encourage Black people, women, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and professionals from diverse backgrounds to apply.

Here, you can be yourself at every stage of your journey. Come join us.

We are looking for someone to work in a team that thinks big, works with attention to detail, collaborates daily, and shares responsibility. We believe in autonomy, the exchange of different experiences, and solutions built together.

Here, growth means sharing knowledge, respecting different ways of thinking, and building trusting relationships while delivering quality technology. If you identify with this way of working, come join us.

What you will do:

Develop technical solutions that meet the requirements presented using the technologies involved in the project; Work within agile team structures based on Agile methodologies, with intense information exchange; Participate in ceremonies for defining the product backlog for Sprints, as well as Dailies, Reviews, and Retrospectives; Keep task boards updated regarding pending tasks, ongoing activities, and possible blockers; Use the company's communication tools to stay updated on schedules, alignments, and team discussions; Deliver code covered by unit and integration tests; Submit Pull Requests for team review.

What we are looking for:

Bachelor's degree in Technology or related fields (ongoing or completed); Experience with version control management using Git and Git Flow; Experience with Docker; Experience in WEB application development using React.js; Experience with front-end componentization; Experience with component styling using styled-components; Experience with unit and integration testing on both front-end and back-end using Jest; Experience in application development using Node.js / Type Script; Experience processing large volumes of transactional data; Experience developing applications with high data volume and asynchronous processing; Experience developing REST API applications; Experience developing applications using Graph QL; Experience developing applications using Mongo DB; Experience developing applications using Postgre SQL; Experience with ETL processes; Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines; Experience with container orchestration using Kubernetes.

Nice to have:

Experience working with basic Cloud services (EC2, S3, RDS); Advanced knowledge of Design Patterns, including SOLID, Clean Code, etc.; Experience creating and managing Cloud Services (AWS, Azure); Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using Terraform, Consul, AWS, Azure, or similar technologies; Previous experience as a Tech Lead or Software Architect; Experience with database migration between Mongo DB and Postgre SQL.

Where you will work:

This is a 100% remote position.

CLT Cooperative

title: Business operations sr analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business operations sr analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit .

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company's journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing Saa S company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities. Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth. Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives. Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed. Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency. Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews. Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (Hub Spot) to enhance efficiency at scale.

Requirements:

3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a Saa S or technology company. Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (Hub Spot knowledge is a plus) Solid understanding of Saa S metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention). Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal). Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives. Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.

Why Join Us?

Opportunity to work in a high-growth Saa S environment with global exposure. Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture. Competitive compensation and benefits package. This is a role based in Brazil, and you'll collaborate closely with teams across the U. S. and Brazil.

Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you'll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Backend team lead (php/laravel)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Backend team lead (php/laravel) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

Position Overview

As a Backend Team Lead, you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities

Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.

Additional Responsibilities

Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration. Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform. Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.

Competencies / Requirements

Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and My SQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.

Benefits

Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (. NET / Angular / Azure) | Remote (Brazil) | $R20,000 per month

We're working exclusively with a fast-scaling, internationally established B2 B Saa S business to find a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants to do more than just ship code; someone who wants to help shape a platform.

The Platform

This isn't a greenfield start-up with no traction, nor a legacy enterprise stuck in technical debt. It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical Saa S platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.

The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.

The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

Full-stack development;. NET 10 / ASP. NET Core on the backend, Angular / Type Script on the front Real-time application development using Signal R Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor) CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern Dev Ops practices Multi-tenant white-label Saa S architecture Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction

This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of commercial software engineering experience Strong. NET / ASP. NET Core and Angular / Type Script skills Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems Cloud-native development on Azure Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding Postgre SQL or equivalent relational database experience Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant Saa S, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.

Why This Role

Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership High ownership, high influence, your decisions will shape the platform A genuinely interesting problem domain with technical complexity that rewards good engineering Up to $R20k-$R23k pcm + 28 days holiday (inclusive of UK bank holidays)

If you're a senior engineer who wants to do the best work of your career on a platform that genuinely matters to its customers, we'd like to speak with you.
