title: Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:

O Grupo Capital:

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil.

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital:

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.

Pré-requisitos:

Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial:

Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá:

Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de partnership estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

Modo de contratação:

Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup Availability to work during overlapping U. S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required) Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

Competitive compensation commensurate with experience Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Manager - accounting advisory & financial reporting (capital markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - accounting advisory & financial reporting (capital markets) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.

The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services, as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, Saa S, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical accounting advisory services, including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis. Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations. Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards. Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices. Assist in M& A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes. Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications & Experience

7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit. Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred. Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks. CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress). Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., Saa S, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects. Excellent communication and client management skills. Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:

O Grupo Capital:

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil.

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital:

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.

Technical Experience:

5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.

O time da Pay Conductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes.

Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando.

Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui.

E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente? SOBRE A VAGA

O time de Marketing da Pay Conductor é responsável por traduzir uma plataforma técnica e robusta em uma marca desejada por empreendedores digitais, varejistas, e-commerces e líderes do mercado financeiro.

A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca.

Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual.

Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. title: Sr. compliance onboarding specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. compliance onboarding specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.

Key Responsibilities

Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance. Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices. Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2 B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions. Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions. Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks. Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance. 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments. Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly. Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus). Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

description:

Hey, Dingus!

Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.

title: Devops pl
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Devops pl em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

#Vem Pra Trinks

Aqui você vai fazer parte de um #timaço que tem a missão de revolucionar o mercado da beleza através de soluções digitais completas para estabelecimentos do ramo, que vão desde a gestão do negócio até serviços financeiros, ferramentas de fidelização, agendamento online e muito mais!

Nosso propósito é ajudar a impulsionar esses negócios permitindo que sejam cada vez mais fortes e tenham mais chances de prosperar. Por aqui, ajudamos pessoas a encontrarem e se conectarem a lugares incríveis para aumentar sua autoestima!

Não faltarão desafios para colocarmos todos os salões do Brasil nos Trinks!

Buscamos um Dev Ops Pleno para atuar no time de infraestrutura, com foco em automação, estabilidade e evolução contínua dos ambientes cloud.

Você será responsável por manter e aprimorar pipelines de CI/CD, gerenciar a infraestrutura na AWS, acompanhar métricas de monitoramento, atuar na resolução de incidentes e liderar a comunicação técnica com times internos e parceiros.

Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:

Garantir a confiabilidade e estabilidade dos ambientes produtivos e de homologação; Promover boas práticas de automação e infraestrutura como código (Ia C); Otimizar o ciclo de deploy e monitoramento contínuo; Conduzir comunicações técnicas com fornecedores e stakeholders; Inspirar confiança e ser referência técnica dentro do time.

O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:

Experiência sólida com AWS (ECS, EC2, RDS, ALB, WAF, Cloud Watch, S3); Conhecimento em Infra as Code (Terraform e/ou Cloud Formation); Experiência com pipelines CI/CD (Git Hub Actions ou similares); Conhecimento em monitoramento, logging e automação de alertas; Experiência com Docker e ambientes Linux e Windows Server; Conhecimento de redes, DNS, SSL, balanceamento e segurança em nuvem; Gostar de compartilhar conhecimentos e de trabalhar com equipe colaborativa.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

Experiência com monitoramento avançado (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana); Conhecimento em scripts de automação (Python, Bash, Power Shell); Vivência com ECS Fargate e pipelines multiambiente; Experiência em otimização de custos em AWS; Certificações AWS ou Dev Ops.

Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:

100% Home office;

Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde Sul América (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto Sul América (custo zero para o colaborador);

Total Pass (plano academia);

Incentivo ao Desenvolvimento: PDI, Capacitações, Feedbacks, Desconto com Faculdades e Cursos de Idiomas;

Bônus por indicação de talentos;

Day off de aniversário e tempo de casa.

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Na Trinks, valorizamos a melhor versão de você mesmo, com incentivos e autonomia para trabalhar, desenvolver e implementar ideias.

E aí, se identificou? Então vem com a gente impulsionar e conectar os negócios de beleza

LGPD na Trinks

Você sabia que a Trinks adota uma rigorosa política para garantir o controle e a transparência no tratamento de dados das pessoas que têm interesse em fazer parte do nosso time? Todas as informações e dados obtidos ao longo do processo seletivo são tratados cuidadosamente, em conformidade com as normas da LGPD.

title: Associate ii, pharmacovigilance - brazil - remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Associate ii, pharmacovigilance - brazil - remote em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide

Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.

What you will do

Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies Attend and present at Investigator Meetings Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed

What you will bring to the role

Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities

Your experience

Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials) Bachelor's degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, Power Point, Word) Excellent written and verbal communication skills Excellent organization skills and attention to detail Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting) Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Web3 & al investment analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Web3 & al investment analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Web3 DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure. We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based), offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights. What You'll Be Doing

Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies. Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems. Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays. Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders. Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects. Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning. Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities. What We're Looking For 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets. Strong understanding of blockchain, De Fi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems. Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape. Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information. Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities. Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views. Fluent English with strong written communication skills. High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation. Why Join Web3 DXB Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses. Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours. Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions. High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally. Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes. Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.

If you're passionate about Web3, AI, and investing, and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we'd love to connect.

title: Senior python engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior python engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:

Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Tik Tok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Big Query, Snowflake, and LLMs like Chat GPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.

We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.

Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.

Our Team:

Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We're a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React

Product:

We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API's. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API's and scalability.

Technology:

We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:

Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint Redis, postgres Linux, docker React, redux for frontend

Role Requirements:

4+ years of programming experience. Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.) Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact Fluency in English is mandatory

How we work:

We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.

Location: Remote

Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

title: Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física)
description:

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:

O Grupo Capital:

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil.

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital:

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.

Pré-requisitos:

Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial:

Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá:

Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de partnership estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

Modo de contratação:

Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Ai software engineer (full-stack)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai software engineer (full-stack) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre a posição

Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Full-Stack Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos que combinam infraestrutura crítica com Inteligência Artificial, em um ambiente onde segurança, escala e performance não são negociáveis.

Você vai liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento, do desenho de interfaces à arquitetura de backend, com integração direta a soluções de IA. Se você tem visão de produto, autonomia técnica e pensa em sistemas antes de pensar em código, queremos conversar. Principais responsabilidades

Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento full-stack: desde interfaces até backend, integrações com modelos de IA e monitoramento em produção; Definir arquitetura e fluxos de usuário utilizando ferramentas e agentes de IA como apoio à geração, testes e evolução de código; Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis para uso intensivo de LLMs, com foco em performance, disponibilidade e experiência do usuário Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD e MLOps para entrega contínua e segura de aplicações e modelos; Garantir qualidade técnica por meio de revisões de código e aderência a boas práticas de engenharia e segurança da informação; Ser referência técnica no time, contribuindo para a disseminação do desenvolvimento assistido por IA. Competências técnicas Sólida base em engenharia de software: algoritmos, design de sistemas e arquitetura full-stack independente de linguagem; Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, Git Hub Copilot ou Replit; Domínio de ecossistemas de IA: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Lang Chain ou Llama Index; Experiência com APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração; Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e No SQL; Capacidade de implementar testes automatizados ao longo do ciclo de vida do software; Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis. Conhecimentos desejáveis Experiência com gestão ágil de produtos, incluindo priorização de backlog e alinhamento técnico-negócio; Fluência em inglês; Conhecimento em ética de IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e mitigação de vieses em modelos. Sobre a UPX

Há mais de 20 anos, a UPX protege ambientes digitais que não podem falhar. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.

Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA.

Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. Se você gosta de pensar no todo, não só na sua parte, você pensa como nós.

Acesse para saber mais.

description:

Aptonet Inc. is seeking experienced Senior IT Technical Recruiters to join our world-class recruiting team. S.-based companies and also support U. S.-based recruiting efforts for our U. S. clients.

Our recruiting team builds the foundation of our clients' success by connecting them with extraordinary talent who share our vision and values.

What We Look For

3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in an agency setting or a high-growth tech environment. Proven experience recruiting for diverse Information Technology roles. Understanding of technology trends and a passion for working with technical professionals. Strong ability to multi-task, manage multiple roles, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal – in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus. High level of professionalism, integrity, and customer service focus. Proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and modern ATS systems.

Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including sourcing, screening, interviews, feedback, offers, and onboarding. Build strong pipelines of both LATAM and U. S.-based technical candidates using creative sourcing strategies. Leverage a variety of sourcing tools, including internet research, Boolean search strings, Linked In, ATS mining, and cold calling. Post job advertisements across relevant platforms such as Linked In, Dice, Career Builder, and niche tech sites. Partner closely with hiring managers and internal teams to understand role requirements and deliver top candidates quickly. Maintain data accuracy in the ATS and track recruiting metrics for reporting and continuous improvement. Develop scalable recruiting processes to support the growth of our recruiting operations in LATAM and the U. S. Act as a trusted representative of Aptonet, promoting our values and delivering a high-quality experience to both candidates and clients.

description:

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (. NET / Angular / Azure) | Remote (Brazil) | $R20,000 per month

We're working exclusively with a fast-scaling, internationally established B2 B Saa S business to find a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants to do more than just ship code; someone who wants to help shape a platform.

The Platform

This isn't a greenfield start-up with no traction, nor a legacy enterprise stuck in technical debt. It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical Saa S platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.

The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.

The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

Full-stack development;. NET 10 / ASP. NET Core on the backend, Angular / Type Script on the front Real-time application development using Signal R Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor) CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern Dev Ops practices Multi-tenant white-label Saa S architecture Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction

This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of commercial software engineering experience Strong. NET / ASP. NET Core and Angular / Type Script skills Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems Cloud-native development on Azure Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding Postgre SQL or equivalent relational database experience Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant Saa S, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.

Why This Role

Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership High ownership, high influence, your decisions will shape the platform A genuinely interesting problem domain with technical complexity that rewards good engineering Up to $R20k-$R23k pcm + 28 days holiday (inclusive of UK bank holidays)

If you're a senior engineer who wants to do the best work of your career on a platform that genuinely matters to its customers, we'd like to speak with you.

title: Arte finalista (pleno/sênior)- banco de talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arte finalista (pleno/sênior)- banco de talentos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica).

O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe In Design já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão.

Pré-Requisitos:

Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas); Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso. Domínio dos software In Design e illustrator; Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo); Disponibilidade para trabalhar das 10h as 19h ou das 13h as 22h.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

Ter atuado ativamente com fechamento de arquivos, arte-final e preparação de arquivos para impressão. Conhecimento em softwares de gestão de tarefas como Monday ou Trello (aqui utilizamos Work Front);

Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)?

#VEMSERSTUDIORX

--

Consideramos todas as aplicações para nossas vagas sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, cultura, origem, religião, deficiência, idade etc. Acreditamos na construção de um mundo mais diverso, com mais representatividade e livre de preconceitos. description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO CARDIOLOGISTA (desejável RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Cardiologia. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

Nosso time de profissionais desempenha um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em cardiologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios cardiológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em cardiologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças cardiológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM CARDIOLOGIA, ou Especialização, residência concluída, ou em andamento.

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista em cardiologia (RQE), emitido pelo Conselho Regional de Medicina do respectivo Estado ; ou matrícula em curso de residência, especialização, ou pós, em andamento; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em cardiologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúde cardiológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership)

Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)

Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.

What You Will Do-

High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.

The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.

Core Traits (Soft Skills):

The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.

What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.

The Challenges You Will Face:

100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

description:

These tools empower universities to expand their initiatives and streamline operations effectively. First Ignite is dedicated to helping academic institutions grow and thrive through innovative technological solutions, making a meaningful impact in the education sector.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Data Engineer. The Data Engineer, will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems focused on acquiring, structuring, and integrating diverse datasets from external and internal sources. This role will be responsible for building reliable data acquisition pipelines, including crawling, scraping, API ingestion, data mining, enrichment, and ETL workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into accurate, usable data for First Ignite's platform.

Qualifications

Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources. Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (Py Spark), Lambda, S3, and RDS Postgre SQL. Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed. Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale. Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems. Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation. Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities. Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.

Requirements

Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines. Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/Py Spark, Lambda, S3, RDS Postgre SQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks. Strong experience with external data acquisition, including building and maintaining crawlers, scrapers, API integrations, and data mining workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into reliable, structured datasets. This includes handling rate limits, source changes, deduplication, validation, enrichment, and pipeline monitoring. Familiarity with RESTful and Graph QL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies. Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications. Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods. Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in Saa S or tech environments. Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices. Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar). LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output. Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

Advanced proficiency using AI generation and automation tools to accelerate asset workflows. Familiarity with modern remote productivity and tracking tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, Notion).

To succeed in this role, you must be obsessed with visual detail and speed. You need to welcome rapidly shifting creative priorities, accept constructive feedback with professionalism, and actively prefer executing high-impact digital storytelling over low-stakes, formulaic editing routines.

We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team.

This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover.

You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real.

If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit.

What You'll Own -----------

Client Services Operations

This is the center of the role.

You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems.

You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared.

The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled.

Pipeline + Relationship Tracking

You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs.

You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client.

Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination

You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar.

That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full.

You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management.

This Role Is a Fit If You:

• Notice gaps and communicate them early

• Take ownership without needing to be chased

• Track details carefully and follow through completely

• Ask smart questions, then remember the answer

• Can support a busy team without adding noise

• Stay calm when priorities shift

• Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful

This Role Is Not a Fit If You:

• Need detailed instructions for every task

• Wait to be told what to do next

• See problems but don't speak up

• Think "done" means "mostly handled"

• Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Clear written and verbal English

• High ownership and follow-through

• Strong attention to detail

• Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities

• Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems

• Fast, stable internet connection

• Professional presence on video

Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools.

Work Setup

Remote, Latin America preferred

Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours

Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours)

How to Apply

We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through.

You'll submit:

• Your resume

• A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you

• Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work

We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes.

We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks.

If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Applied ai engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Applied ai engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Applied AI Engineer Who We Are

Enlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs. The role

This is a hands-on, embedded engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll move fluidly between building AI agents, shipping customer-facing AI products, and wiring up the data that feeds both, talking to the people who'll use what you build, iterating in front of them, and turning rough ideas into things that work.

In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. You'll be deployed against our own business and customers rather than external clients, but the instincts are the same: high autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly.

This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome. What you'll build

You'll lead or contribute to three flagship initiatives:

Agentic orchestration. We run our development and operations on an internal system of specialized AI agents, built on Claude Code, that plan, build, and review each other's work before anything ships, with reusable skills and adversarial review gates that keep quality high. You'll operate it, extend it, build new agents and skills for our specific workflows, and keep those quality gates sharp. Conversational AI grounded in the customer. Build AI chat and voice experiences that tap into a customer's profile and behavioral signals to have genuinely helpful, personalized conversations with them about their relationship and life questions, the core of what our customers come to us for. This spans retrieval over customer profiles, conversation memory, and (on the roadmap) real-time voice. Signal-based personalized marketing. Turn customer signals into tailored marketing: segments, scoring, and personalized messaging pushed through our marketing stack. This extends our existing lead-intelligence pipeline.

You won't do all three every week, but over a quarter you'll likely touch all of them. Our stack

AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, Eleven Labs for voice Primary language: Python Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools Tooling: Git/Git Hub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows (some of our agent tooling touches shell + Type Script/Node)

You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it. What we're looking for

Hands-on, embedded instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain your work to non-engineers clearly Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), chaining, evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the judgment to build quality gates rather than skip them Comfortable in shell and Type Script/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software Sound judgment around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that talks with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries built in. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought Care with personal data: customer profiles and conversation content are sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA) Nice to have Prior solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for Experience with conversational/voice AI: TTS/STT, low-latency streaming, voice-agent frameworks (Live Kit, Pipecat, Vapi) Experience in DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance marketing Familiarity with attribution/CRM platforms and marketing APIs Recommendation, personalization, or feature-store experience Familiarity with agentic frameworks (Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at Why this role is different Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast. You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly. AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years. Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business. How to apply

Record a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

title: Client services assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client services assistant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Client Services Assistant

Remote, Latin America

Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together.

We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team.

This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover.

You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real.

If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit.

What You'll Own -----------

Client Services Operations

This is the center of the role.

You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems.

You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared.

The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled.

Pipeline + Relationship Tracking

You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs.

You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client.

Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination

You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar.

That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full.

You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management.

This Role Is a Fit If You:

• Notice gaps and communicate them early

• Take ownership without needing to be chased

• Track details carefully and follow through completely

• Ask smart questions, then remember the answer

• Can support a busy team without adding noise

• Stay calm when priorities shift

• Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful

This Role Is Not a Fit If You:

• Need detailed instructions for every task

• Wait to be told what to do next

• See problems but don't speak up

• Think "done" means "mostly handled"

• Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented

Requirements

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Clear written and verbal English

• High ownership and follow-through

• Strong attention to detail

• Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities

• Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems

• Fast, stable internet connection

• Professional presence on video

Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools.

Work Setup

Remote, Latin America preferred

Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours

Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours)

How to Apply

We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through.

You'll submit:

• Your resume

• A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you

• Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work

We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes.

We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks.

If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.
